rules.probability: OUR model only: projection pmf (models.v2.runtime) for props, game_model adapter for game markets; market no-vig is a comparison column
rules.sort: our model probability, descending (one entry per player-market / game-market-side; most likely strike, ladder attached); market-only rows unranked

rules.note: same-game legs are correlated. Combo legs require Model >=89%, yes ask <=90c, confirmed starters, no known back-to-back, Model no more than 15 points above ask, fewer than four fouls, and blowout checks. Maximum one leg per player and two per game; joint Model >=10% and estimated EV >=0. Independent products are estimates; quote markup median 1.10059432 from five observations on 2026-10-21.

rules.readiness: No fresh Kalshi ladders (five-minute capture window). Run one bounded refresh, then rebuild.

rules.probability: OUR model only: projection pmf (models.v2.runtime) for props, game_model adapter for game markets; market no-vig is a comparison column
rules.sort: our model probability, descending (one entry per player-market / game-market-side; most likely strike, ladder attached); market-only rows unranked
rules.readiness: No fresh Kalshi ladders (five-minute capture window). Run one bounded refresh, then rebuild.

rules.note: same-game legs are correlated. Combo legs require Model >=89%, yes ask <=90c, confirmed starters, no known back-to-back, Model no more than 15 points above ask, fewer than four fouls, and blowout checks. Maximum one leg per player and two per game; joint Model >=10% and estimated EV >=0. Independent products are estimates; quote markup median 1.10059432 from five observations on 2026-10-21.
rules.price_check: Recorder capture within five minutes of rebuild start; offline rebuild, no live revalidation.
